Discretisation settings

Source: R/tuning.R
ode_tuning.Rd

Numerical settings for run_simulation_ode(), passed as its tuning argument. Every default is the validated choice, and a run with the defaults is the reference configuration. run_simulation_ode() also accepts a plain named list of the fields to change: fields left out keep their defaults, and an unknown field is an error.

Usage

ode_tuning(
  age_lower = default_age_lower(),
  n_ph = NULL,
  n_phc = NULL,
  n_sub = 32L,
  odin_file = NULL,
  ...,
  batch_bins = TRUE
)

Arguments

age_lower

age-group lower edges in years. The default is default_age_lower(), a 118-group grid log-spaced between pinned reporting ages and weighted towards the under-fives; its documentation gives the grid's accuracy and cost. Must be finite, start at 0 and increase strictly, with at least two edges, and must be in years: a top edge above 1000 is rejected as a grid given in days.

Each day every group loses its ageing and mortality fraction out of the same stock as the day's other exits, so the narrowest group must be wide enough to hold them together. Progression and clearance do not depend on transmission, and a grid with a group too narrow for them, a little over a day, is an error before the run. Infection is checked as the run goes: a run in which any compartment falls below zero stops with an error naming the day and the age group. That takes several consecutive groups a day or two wide at an EIR in the hundreds; the default grid's narrowest groups are 16.6 days wide.

n_ph, n_phc

stage counts of the post-treatment (Ph) and chemoprevention (Ph_c) prophylaxis chains. NULL (default) matches each chain to the drug's Weibull protection curve. A stage is left with a fixed probability each day, so it lasts a geometric number of days, and a chain matches the protection's mean M and variance V with M^2 / (V + M) stages: 10 for SP-AQ as chemoprevention, 9 for DHA-PQP. Ph follows the treated stage Tr, so its count matches the variance of the whole Tr + Ph sojourn and its mean is the protection left after Tr: 9 stages for SP-AQ, 10 for DHA-PQP, and 1 for AL, whose 10-day protection is already less variable than Tr itself. A drug mixture is moment-matched as a mixture.

A stage lasts at least a day and also loses its ageing and mortality fraction each day, so the default is limited to what fits the shortest-protecting drug on the schedule and capped at 20, and an explicit count that does not fit is an error. The count is fixed for the run, sized at the seed's drug mix, so a first-line switch moves the chain's mean, not its shape.

n_sub

sub-steps per day of the mosquito model, integrated by an exponential midpoint rule (second order, and stable however stiff the larval equations become). Once a run is on its cycle the error falls fourfold with each doubling. At the default of 32, a seasonal run's daily EIR stays within 2.4e-4 of the converged solution at the seasonal trough (5.5e-6 of its peak), comparable to the per-step tolerance to which malariasimulation integrates its own mosquito model (r_tol = a_tol = 1e-4); 8 leaves it 3.6e-3 off, a slight shift in the phase of the seasonal cycle. Annual means agree to about 4e-6 at 32 and 5e-5 at 8, and a run with no seasonality and no interventions is exact to 1e-11 at any count. The mosquito model is a small part of the day, so 32 costs 2 to 13% more than 8.

odin_file

optional path to an odin source to compile instead of the generator built into the package: a discrete-time model with the built-in one's parameters and states. For development; needs 'odin2' and a C++ toolchain. The compiled model is cached by path for the session, so an edit to the file needs a new session.

...

the ODE solver's controls (atol, rtol, step_size_max) and the Erlang lag stage counts (n_eir, n_foim, n_eip) are accepted with a warning and ignored: the model advances one day at a time, with the IBM's own delay lines, so there is no solver to control and no lag to discretise. Any other name is an error.

batch_bins

under P. vivax, whether hypnozoite batch counts share levels. malariasimulation gives each person a count of hypnozoite batches, 0 to kmax, and fleet holds every vivax compartment and immunity stock at each level of that ladder, so its length accounts for most of a vivax run's cost. With TRUE (default), counts 0 to 3 and kmax have a level each and the counts between share levels in pairs, the people within a pair spread as a Poisson fitted to the levels either side. That gives eight levels for the default kmax = 10, which take a quarter less time than eleven and move no output of the fleetcheck vivax suite by more than 0.4%. FALSE gives every count its own level. Ignored under P. falciparum.

Value

A list of class fleet_ode_tuning.

See also

run_simulation_ode(), default_age_lower()

Examples

ode_tuning()$n_sub
#> [1] 32
# a finer age grid, to check how much of a severe-incidence level is the grid's
length(ode_tuning(age_lower = default_age_lower(n_group = 417))$age_lower)
#> [1] 417
